g.title: CurrentPackageIntegration
g.text: GC2D | Detailed package and integration architecture
Eight source owners, from physical field to immutable trajectory. Read each column vertically; follow numbered EXECUTION cards for runtime order.
Blue: shared lifecycle and contracts. Orange: method configuration. Green: numerical operations and results. Purple: optional observation and analysis.
N = particle count; m = physical state size; q = internal state size; T = requested saved times. Module paths are relative to the repository root.

g.title: cluster_contracts
g.text: contracts/ | Shared input, step and output records

g.title: Potential
g.text: Grid; spatial mode amplitudes; time dependence.
evaluate(t, x, y, dx, dy, dt)
Interpolation and field derivatives live here.
Dynamics consumes the same physical field.

g.title: H5Loader
g.text: HDF5 field, magnetic field, characteristic length,
Normalize measured coordinates and field data.
Study parameters remain explicit at the caller.
Metadata describes the loaded physical source.

g.title: Dynamics
g.text: Classical and adaptive methods evaluate the field.
Physics is independent of initial geometry,
step size, solver tolerances and saved history.

g.title: GC
g.text: Field uses the gyroaveraged electric potential.

g.title: Grid
g.text: Periodic spatial axes; shape and spacing.
normalize(x, y): wrap coordinates into the cell.
Potential owns interpolation on this grid.
Physical periodicity is separate from the
integration time grid and output sample grid.

g.title: FC
g.text: Numerical families check their required interface.

g.title: Capabilities
g.text: Analytic particle blocks for supported solvers.

g.title: ProblemContract
g.text: Validate compatible physical dimensions and finite state.
Saved times include both requested interval endpoints.
The caller assembles physics and initial geometry.
The request owns temporal controls shared by all methods.

g.title: Initial
g.text: set_initial_state validates and copies the vector.
Concrete geometry supplies the physical layout.
The caller combines this configuration and

g.title: InitialModels
g.text: Packed blocks: x, y, vx, vy.

g.title: Layouts
g.text: Each coordinate block contains all N particles.
Solution retains the source layout for interpretation.

g.title: Area
g.text: Initial boundary points and area calculation.
Same packed GC state as other configurations.
Geometry does not own an integration loop.
Studies choose initial positions and sampling.

g.title: Physical
g.text: One spatial copy; m physical coordinates.
With per-particle time and kappa: q = 4N.

g.title: Doubled
g.text: GC internal size: q = 4N, or 6N with energy.
Accepted projected states have identical copies.
Off-diagonal states occur inside the spatial maps.
Only spatial differences enter the projection.
Time and kappa remain passive coordinates.

g.title: Maps
g.text: Spatial doubled state and signed stage duration.
Spatial shears evaluate the physical dynamics.
Optional harmonic coupling mixes the copies.
Accepted shear inputs support energy and tangents.

g.title: Passive
g.text: d kappa / dt = -partial_t H; one value per particle.
Time blocks follow the prescribed integration time.
Energy tracking does not alter the physical root

g.title: SplitContracts
g.text: Methods bind GCDoubledMaps directly and use
DoubledFormulation for accepted state and export.

g.title: LayoutContract
g.text: initial_state and layout describe the packed physical input.
Concrete GC / FC layouts live in initial_conditions/.

g.title: Families
g.text: All extend IntegrationMethod. Public options are
reusable; resources are initialized for each run.

g.title: Initialize
g.text: Select and bind the state formulation.
Initialize state, metadata and numerical resources.
Bind composition recipe, maps and projection.
Bind SolverOptions and optional event adapters.
Create one fresh SciPy solver session per run.
The constructor remains a reusable configuration.

g.title: Advance
g.text: Fixed: h is the complete map duration.
Adaptive: h bounds the live solver accepted step.
The coordinator invokes an installed observer.

g.title: Projection
g.text: One outer Hairer projection per complete recipe.
Average the two copies after the full composition.
No nonlinear solve in midpoint methods.

g.title: Composition
g.text: Alternate adjoint_map, direct_map in recipe order.
h_i = coefficient_i * h; preserve negative durations.
Adjoint evaluates at stage start, direct at stage end.

g.title: NumericalSupport
g.text: Scaled residual tolerance and common work counters.
BM4 Newton also supports finite differences.
Broyden uses secant updates without Jacobians.
physical stages and nonlinear convergence scales.

g.title: NewRun
g.text: new_run copies constructor options to a fresh instance.
Bind problem and request; call initialize (3).
Copy and freeze initial_state and metadata.
Reuse options by creating another fresh run.

g.title: Coordinator
g.text: Validate interval and internal state; record statistics.
Dispatch optional event; save requested samples.
Check full time coverage; export physical history.
Merge metadata, work, auxiliary data and aliases.

g.title: Controller
g.text: Off-grid outputs use independent shortened maps.
Calls advance on a persistent DOP853 / Radau solver.
Backend retries stay internal; sample dense output.

g.title: Collector
g.text: Small per-step metric arrays with stable shapes.
Record accepted times and effective step sizes.
Event histories are retained only by observers.
Output-only sampling is separate from main-step work.

g.title: Export
g.text: Formulation extracts states [m, T] and auxiliaries.
Export does not repeat numerical projection.

g.title: ObservationDispatch
g.text: then invoke the callback on its independent event.
Extended adapters reuse accepted composition details.
Optional observers retain analysis and persistence data.
Event mutations cannot change integration history.

g.title: StepContract
g.text: Internal states are separate from physical observer snapshots.
The collector stores statistics, not numerical detail histories.

g.title: Simulate
g.text: The inherited lifecycle starts in integration/ (2).
Stateless orchestration around the numerical run.
The same call resumes with IntegrationData (8).

g.title: Facade
g.text: Re-exports point to their canonical implementations.

g.title: Failure
g.text: Non-finite maps; singular solve; iteration limit.
Invalid accepted intervals or final output.
Integration finalization marks the run finished.
Numerical exceptions propagate to the caller.
A failed run does not produce a successful Solution.

g.title: Resume
g.text: Physical row count matches the initial state.
The first saved column equals the initial state.
Expose the validated physical Solution to the caller.

g.title: OutputContract
g.text: Returned by the numerical method to simulate.
Method-specific ABBA / BM4 events preserve accepted traces.
Caller-owned observers retain copied events when requested.

g.title: Solution
g.text: diagnostics: read-only mapping of copied values.
Own copies of trajectory and diagnostic arrays.
Numerical run resources are not retained.

g.title: Validation
g.text: Finite increasing times and finite state history.
Compatible time and state array dimensions.
Copy and freeze arrays; freeze diagnostic mapping.
Simulation separately checks agreement with inputs.

g.title: Accessors
g.text: Source geometry preserves the coordinate convention.

g.title: ResultUse
g.text: Compose reproducible runs and reference comparisons.
Interpret physical errors and method diagnostics.
Plots, summaries and animations consume results.
For time-dependent fields, compare physical H
with the reference history; H need not be conserved.

g.title: Reading
g.text: HOW TO READ THE CURRENT WORKFLOW
Column order is source responsibility, not a sequence of imports or runtime calls.
potential -> dynamics; dynamics + initial_conditions -> InitialValueProblem; caller selects method + request.
(1) simulate -> (2) new_run -> (3) initialize -> (4) integrate_method -> (5) controller -> (6) advance.
repeat (5)-(6), collect and sample; (7) export IntegrationData -> (8) simulate resumes -> (9) Solution.
Solid arrows: selected calls or required data. Dotted blue: returns. Dashed purple: optional events or analysis. Red dashed: failures.
Unconnected cards document capabilities or ownership; they do not imply additional runtime stages.
contracts/ owns shared records; dynamics/protocols.py owns physical capabilities; formulations/base.py owns split-map protocols.
studies/ assembles experiments; diagnostics/ owns opt-in observers and persistence; visualization/ owns presentation.
